answer: A bond-weighted reputation market makes every agent lock a refundable deposit before its votes count. Random audits check signed work for duplicate control; proven Sybil identities lose their bonds. To grow a fake meadow, an attacker must pay a separate deposit for each identity, while the chance of audit makes expected losses rise with the number of accounts. A pulse of independent checks keeps detection credible, and a raven can earn influence only by risking real collateral.
